title: Personal Training Packages: resolving the final number of sessions forfeited at lapse
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the status-and-timing gate and the membership grace credit together resolve the final number of sessions forfeited when a package lapses.

## Rule
Where the status-and-timing gate for lapsing is not met, zero sessions are forfeited and the package does not lapse. Where the gate is met, the number of sessions forfeited is the package's remaining session count at the moment of lapsing, less any club-membership grace credit, as already determined. A package with zero sessions remaining at that moment forfeits zero sessions but still transitions to expired.

## Points of judgement
The status-and-timing gate is resolved first and independently of the membership grace credit: only once that gate is met does the membership grace credit computation determine how many of the remaining sessions are actually forfeited. A package that has no sessions left to forfeit still lapses to expired status once the gate is met, even though the forfeiture amount in that case is zero.
